facts.title: Volley and header reductions
facts.text: Volley buff halved; header strength bonus reduced from 50% to 30%.

facts.title: Release effects
facts.text: Master at release: stronger aerial volley, 1.5× jump, 20% speed boost, 25% shot boost, 50% header strength, +2 headers. Later September balance reduced the volley and header bonuses.

history.title: Nagi, Loki and Lavinho balance
history.text: Detailed nerfs and removals for Nagi and McNagi, Loki aerial trap removal, Lavinho balance and flow adjustments.
